arm_text.original: question plus the matching real image
arm_text.blank_same_geometry: same question plus a neutral image with identical pixel dimensions
arm_text.mismatched_same_domain: same question plus the next real image from the same source domain
arm_text.text_only: same question with no image; sequence geometry is not controlled

limitations.fc2: official vLLM NVFP4 emulation backend; the native fused kernel does not expose FC2 input
limitations.pruning: reversible route ablation, not a physically pruned checkpoint
